title: 設定頁的搜尋框更清楚一致
summary: 動作列與 AI 命令改用一致的搜尋圖示與框內提示，讓搜尋區域更簡潔、容易辨識。
highlights: 搜尋提示移入輸入框，兩頁使用相同高度與對齊方式。
輸入後可使用框內的清除按鈕，立即重新搜尋。
保留搜尋框的無障礙名稱，支援繁體中文與英文介面。
usage: 開啟設定的「動作列」或「AI 命令」，直接在搜尋框輸入文字；按右側清除按鈕即可清空搜尋，不需額外設定。

en.title: Clearer, consistent search in settings
en.summary: Toolbar and AI Commands now share a search icon and in-field hint for a cleaner, more recognizable search area.
highlights: Search hints move inside matching, consistently aligned fields.
An in-field clear button appears after typing so you can quickly start another search.
Accessible search names remain available in both Traditional Chinese and English.
en.usage: Open Toolbar or AI Commands in settings and type in the search field. Use the clear button on the right to reset your query. No additional setup is required.
